technique_name: Describe the architecture of the PyTorch framework.
description: PyTorch is an open source deep learning library developed by Facebook's AI Research lab. It is based on Torch, a numerical computing library based on the programming language Lua. PyTorch provides two core features: a powerful multidimensional tensor library optimized for speed and flexibility and a deep learning library for efficiently building and deploying deep neural networks.
